name: replace_file_content
title: Flowork Replace File Content
description: Precise search-and-replace for a single contiguous block of code within [StartLine, EndLine]. TargetContent must match exactly. ReplacementContent replaces it completely. Multi-OS CRLF/LF safe.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

AllowMultiple.description: If true, multiple occurrences of TargetContent will be replaced.

Description.description: Brief explanation of what this change did.

EndLine.description: The ending line number of the chunk (1-indexed).

Instruction.description: A description of the changes that you are making to the file.

ReplacementContent.description: The content to replace the target content with.

StartLine.description: The starting line number of the chunk (1-indexed).

TargetContent.description: The exact string to be replaced. Must match exactly character-for-character including leading whitespace.

TargetFile.description: The target file to modify (absolute or workspace path).

keywords.description: Mandatory on the first tool call of a turn: Comma-separated technical domain keywords in English (e.g. 'sqlite wal concurrency' or 'canvas ui animation'). Used by Sovereign Skill Radar to search relevant skills across local storage and the official Flowork OS repository, presenting up to 3 candidates for optional pinning.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs (displayed live to the user on every tool HUD and used on the first call to recall up to 3 memories from .fl_brain).

fl_brain_ref.description: Path to referenced .fl_brain memory (e.g. '.fl_brain/memories/awenk/agent/remedy_wal.md') or 'none' / 'fresh_solution' if no existing memory applies. Hallucinated references that do not exist on disk are rejected.
